field_of_expertise.detail: Architect by training, serving as Executive Officer; brought polar/extreme-environment experience from prior service on a Japanese Antarctic Research Expedition

source_citation: SRC-mars160-fmars-crew-arrival, SpaceFlight Insider, 'Mars 160: 6-person crew arrives at Arctic station', July 2017: Executive Officer described as Japanese, an architect by training who brought polar/extreme-environment experience from a prior Japanese Antarctic Research Expedition. Role and nationality independently corroborated by Mars Society mission materials (mars160.marssociety.org/meet-the-crew/) and Space.com's 'Notes from Mars 160' series profiling the Executive Officer's background in space architecture. No explicit gender pronoun found in the material reviewed; gender recorded as undisclosed.
